apiProxy.note: CVA agent's access-key API: stack cva-agent-key (shubham-aivar/cva-output-agent, deploy/key) in the aivar-vision account 604775478403, CloudFront d2f11is2hu6tzu.cloudfront.net in front of one EC2 instance. /agents/cva-output/api/runs becomes /api/runs. Every route except /health needs X-Access-Key: the CVA key gate (infra/key_gates.py) adds it from Secrets Manager ingram-mm-dashboard/cva-output-access-key for signed-in people; the screens never hold the key. The instance is stopped every night at 15:30 UTC by that account's off-hours policy (start: deploy/key/deploy.sh start). Forward all methods, the query string and every header except Host. Do not cache.

note: The dashboard serves the screens (src/features/cva-output). Only /api/ is proxied. File downloads on the hosted site live at /download/, which this proxy does not cover, so the Outputs step lists the file names the service returns.
